summary: Verified BRSR question assignment fixes via backend API tests (3/3 pass). Verified end-to-end via POST /api/tracking/all/assign and READ via GET /api/tracking/all/frameworks/brsr/sections/SECTION_B.

Reassign same question to users B & C (replacing A & B) - assignees == {B, C} exactly; due_date updated
Reassign with 3 users - all 3 appear in assignees list (no drop)

READ path in esg_tracking/service.py now sources assignees from esg_assignment_assignees collection with legacy assigned_to_user_id fallback - good backward compat.
bulk_assign_disclosures passes entity_type='question' & entity_id=q_key to assignment_service_v2 - honored by the create path (line 170 in assignment_service_v2.py).
Note: existing_assignments dict is built but only used implicitly via skip_already_assigned; since create_or_update_assignment handles upsert internally this is fine but slightly redundant.
Minor: replace_assignees is called with new_user_ids in the update branch - confirmed via test_2 that old users are removed and new set is exact.
